values.note: 60 campsites including one host site; some have tent pads.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/rocky-gorge-campground ('The campground has 60 campsites including one host site, with tables, fire rings and some with tent pads and RV sites able to accommodate up to 32' RV'; last updated May 1, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The description lists potable water, but the page's amenity box says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' Dock and a fully developed boat launch on Lake Koocanusa.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/rocky-gorge-campground ('Amenities include potable water, vault toilets, dock and a fully developed boat launch'; amenity box 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed from Memorial Day through Labor Day, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/rocky-gorge-campground ('Single Site: $16 per night', '$16.00 daily fee per sleep unit'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/rocky-gorge-campground ('50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS (Kootenai NF, Rexford/Fortine RD) campground ~26 mi SW of Eureka off Hwy 37 at ~2,490 ft, adjacent to Lake Koocanusa. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated May 1, 2026): confirmed 60 sites incl. host, 32-ft RVs, vault toilets, potable water (amenity box contradicts), $16/night, 50% Senior/Access discount (now on the entry); added year-round availability (managed Memorial Day - Labor Day). Not stated: reservations/FCFS (derived left), stay limit (derived 14 left; page points to regional alerts). Kootenai flood-washout alert lists no road near Hwy 37. Note: dropped restated values and the stale '$9/night' (page: $16).
